title: pua_usrloc Module
content_markdown: The pua_usrloc is the connector between usrloc and pua modules. Using this module, phones which have no support for presence can be seen as online/offline.
overview: The pua_usrloc is the connector between usrloc and pua modules. Using this module, phones which have no support for presence can be seen as online/offline.
how_it_works: It creates the environment to send PUBLISH requests for user location records, on specific events (e.g., when new record is added in usrloc, a PUBLISH with status open (online) is issued; when expires, it sends closed (offline)).

exported_parameters.name: default_domain
exported_parameters.description: The default domain to use when constructing the presentity uri if it is missing from recorded aor.

exported_parameters.name: entity_prefix
exported_parameters.description: The prefix when construstructing entity attribute to be added to presence node in xml pidf. (ex: pres:user@domain ).

exported_parameters.name: presence_server
exported_parameters.description: The the address of the presence server. If set, it will be used as outbound proxy when sending PUBLISH requests.

exported_functions.name: pua_set_publish
exported_functions.description: The function is used to mark REGISTER requests that have to issue a PUBLISH. The PUBLISH is issued when REGISTER is saved in location table.
